load_pix3d_json: load a Pix3D COCO-format JSON annotation file into Detectron2 dataset dict format with camera intrinsics and 3D data
run_pix3d_loader_cli: run the Pix3D dataset loader module via CLI to load annotations and visualize them as images
test_load_pix3d_json: test the load_pix3d_json function by passing a JSON file path, image root, and dataset name
review_load_pix3d_json: review the load_pix3d_json function to understand how it maps COCO category IDs to contiguous IDs and extracts camera matrices
refactor_load_pix3d_json: refactor the load_pix3d_json function to support additional 3D annotation fields like point clouds or depth maps
